domestic_self_drive.guidance: 优先检查租车/自驾可行性、停车与道路风险

rules: Search every route-changing scheduled leg, not only named ferry operators.
Exact-date departures require a primary official source and a retrieval date.
Published reference departures must show their effective period and must not be presented as future commitments.
On-demand services do not require fabricated departure times.
Future unpublished and unverified statuses retain an explicit recheck notice.
